description: Create a European payment QR code. Auto-selects SPAYD for CZ/SK IBANs and EPC/GiroCode for other SEPA IBANs.

bic.description: Optional BIC for EPC/GiroCode line 5. Ignored with a warning for SPAYD.

constant_symbol.description: Optional Czech constant symbol for SPAYD.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to CZK for SPAYD and EUR for EPC.

iban.description: Recipient IBAN. Validated with the IBAN mod-97 checksum.

message.description: Optional payment message or EPC remittance text.

standard.description: Payment QR standard. Defaults to auto detection.

variable_symbol.description: Optional reference: goes to remittance (line 11) for EPC, to X-VS for SPAYD.

name: qr_payment
